newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra falls on Pulmicort rumour.
newsitem.headline: Astra falls on Pulmicort rumour.

text.p: Shares in Swedish pharmaceuticals firm Astra fell 4.5 crowns to 329 crowns on Tuesday on rumours of a delay to FDA approval for its anti- asthma treatment Pulmicort Turbohaler.
"There are rumours that FDA approval may be delayed by another six months," said a broker.
Astra spokesman Staffan Ternby rejected the rumour, saying Astra had received a letter from the FDA with a few questions "of a not very complex nature."
"There are rumours this may have been some form of warning letter but that's not right...we see it as a sign there are no more bigger issues still outstanding," he added.
